conceptual_change: Implement a volatility regime filter by requiring the current 14-period Average True Range (ATR) to be greater than 1.5 times its 20-period simple moving average as a prerequisite for entry signals.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt was rejected due to lack of engine implementation for the volatility filter. This hypothesis formalizes the requirement into the execution logic to filter out low-volatility, range-bound periods that contribute to false breakout signals.
